title: Aegis SDM Monte Carlo Simulator: counter-check policies for NTAG 424 DNA TT
description: Monte Carlo simulator of server-side counter-check policies for NXP NTAG 424 DNA TT Secure Dynamic Messaging, part of the AEGIS anti-counterfeiting system for gold bars. It models the tag, the verifier, honest owners over a lossy and reordering channel, and five attackers, and reports honest false-reject and attack-acceptance rates with 95% Wilson intervals. Run npm test, then npm run experiments.
